column1: # Pixel shaders that may be blended with their output 1 as the second source (dual-source blending): dmsh_build.py gives each a dual-source entry point (fs_dual); a pipeline takes it only when its target 0 reads SRC1. These are all 65 of the game's 2,599 pixel shaders that write exactly colours 0 and 1, because most areas are not reachable on a test route. GitHub issue #1010 named 2251e8cf4ea90411, whose log had a red line for it.
